PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.BasicDataHi: General template data. Persistence and application are owned by the host container.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.DCSourceHin: The DC is supplied by the source when the affliction is applied.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.ExposureHin: Controls whether exposure requires a check and when the first stage begins.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.Identificat: Controls how a newly applied affliction is initially presented to the affected player.
The template defines only the initial state. The later controller can move between hidden, suspected, and identified during play.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.ImagePicker: The Foundry image picker is unavailable.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.InheritsDef: This stage uses the default stage progression check.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.InjuryPoiso: This poison can be applied to a weapon or attack. Applying it asks for the number of charges; the default is 1.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.ListHint: Separate multiple values with commas, semicolons, or line breaks.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.MaximumDura: Starts when the first active stage begins. Onset or incubation time does not count toward this duration.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.Name: Name
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.NoDefaultSt: No default progression check is performed when a stage expires.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.NoInitialCh: No saving throw on exposure. The affliction proceeds directly to onset or stage 1.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.NoStageEffe: This stage currently has no mechanical Effect Definition.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.OverrideSav: Use custom settings for this check
Off: this check inherits execution and visibility from the affliction defaults.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.SaveChecksH: Defines the checks referenced by exposure and stage progression gates.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.SavePolicyD: These settings apply to every saving throw unless an individual check overrides them.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.StageCheckH: By default, this stage inherits the global progression gate.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.StageEffect: Edited with Critical Forge's Embedded Effect Editor.
Effect name, image, and lifetime are managed by the stage. Only mechanical components are edited here.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.StageProgre: Used when a stage expires unless that stage overrides the progression gate.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.StagesHint: Each stage has its own duration, narrative description, and optional mechanical Effect Definition.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.ValidationH: Validates the data contract and embedded Effect Definitions through Critical Forge.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Editor.VirulentHin: Two consecutive successful saves are required to reduce the stage by 1. A critical success immediately reduces the stage by 1 instead of 2.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Forge.CopyToWorld: Copy as your own template to the Item Library
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Forge.DefinitionCo: Copied the Affliction Definition to the clipboard.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Forge.DiscardPromp: The current affliction template contains unsaved changes. Discard them?
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Forge.DraftNotice: Affliction templates can now be saved to the Item Library and writable Item compendia.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Forge.EditorMountF: The Embedded Affliction Editor could not be loaded.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Forge.GmOnly: Only the GM can open Affliction Forge.

PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.NumericModifier.Hi: Stage-bound PF2e modifiers, such as movement penalties. Multiple selectors may be entered as a comma-separated list.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.NumericModifier.No: No numeric modifiers in this stage.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.EffectHin: The effect is executed through the Effect Engine whenever its interval becomes due.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.EffectMan: This effect definition is managed by Affliction Forge.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.Execution: A periodic affliction effect could not be executed.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.Hint: Repeatedly executes an effect while the stage is active after a fixed or rolled interval.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.IntervalF: Optional, e.g. 1d20. A formula overrides the fixed value and is rolled again for every new interval.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.Label: Label
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.NoEffectD: No effect definition has been added yet.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Periodic.None: No periodic effects in this stage.

PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.PreAction.ActionKi: The PF2e spell workflow is checked automatically. Other item activations can use the public pre-action API.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.PreAction.Blocked: {gate}: The action is prevented by the failed check.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.PreAction.Error: The affliction pre-action check could not be resolved. The action was not performed as a precaution.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.PreAction.Hint: Checks immediately before matching actions to determine whether the affliction prevents the action. The check occurs before resource consumption.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.PreAction.Label: Label
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.PreAction.Required: Comma-separated PF2e traits that must all be present, for example concentrate.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.PreAction.Title: Pre-Action Gates
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.CheckHint: Optional. With no auxiliary save, the reaction resolves immediately.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.Condition: Optional. Comma-separated PF2e condition slugs, such as wounded. Empty means any increased valued condition.
Only for condition gained/increased. Adjusts the triggering condition value by this integer amount.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.Controlle: Optional. After the auxiliary save, the affliction can automatically recover or end depending on the result.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.DamageTyp: Optional. Comma-separated PF2e damage types, such as slashing. Empty means any positive damage.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.DirectRes: Trigger resolved without an auxiliary save.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.EffectHin: The auxiliary save never changes the stage. The effect executes only for the selected outcomes above.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.EffectMan: Affliction Forge manages the identity and short lifecycle of this effect.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.Hint: Optional auxiliary checks triggered by a supported game event while this stage is active. They do not progress the affliction stage by themselves.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.Label: Label
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.NoEffect: No reaction effect applies to this result.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.NoEffectD: No mechanical effect is defined for this reaction yet.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.None: No event reactions are defined for this stage.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reaction.Title: Event Reactions
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.DragHint: Drag onto an Actor or token to apply this Affliction, or into a text field to insert an Affliction link.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.DropFail: The Affliction could not be applied by drag and drop.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.DropNoTo: Drop the Affliction directly onto a token.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.DropOnHo: Drop an Affliction here to link it.

PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.HostEmpt: No Affliction is linked to this attack or ability yet.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.HostPoli: The link stores only the Affliction, trigger, and application mode. The Affliction Engine owns progression after the host actually applies it.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.InjuryPo: The poison is delivered only if the attack deals slashing or piercing damage. A critical failure, or an attack that deals no slashing/piercing damage, consumes 1 charge without delivery; on a normal failure the poison remains.
“{affliction}” on “{item}”: last charge consumed; the poison was removed from the weapon.
Injury poisons can currently be applied only to weapons or real attack Items.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.ReadOnly: This source is read-only. Existing Afflictions can only be viewed.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.StrikePo: Injury poison “{affliction}” on this weapon; remaining charges: {charges}.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Reference.TextDrop: Drag into a rich-text editor to insert a clickable Affliction link.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Restrictions.Affli: {value} HP of affliction damage cannot be healed until the corresponding restriction ends.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Restrictions.Compo: Each persistent effect component may optionally use its own lifetime. “Inherit stage default” uses the stage persistence setting.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Restrictions.Condi: {condition} cannot be reduced below {minimum} while this affliction is active.
Format: slug:minimum, for example sickened:2. Without a value, the current condition cannot be reduced or removed.
{condition} cannot be removed while this affliction is active.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Restrictions.Heali: Hit points cannot be healed during this stage.
“Affliction damage” protects only HP damage caused by this affliction. “No HP healing” blocks all HP healing.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Restrictions.RootH: Apply during every active stage of the affliction and combine with stage-specific restrictions.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Restrictions.Stage: Apply only while this stage is active.
PF2E_AFFLICTION_FORGE.Restrictions.Title: Restrictions
